title: WPMS/3289/2017 of Smt. Kamla Devi AND ANOTHER Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

WPMS NO. 3289 of 2017
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. A.K. Bansal, Advocate for the
petitioners.
Mr. Yogesh Pandey, Addl. C.S.C.
alongwith Mr. Anurag Bisaria, Standing
Counsel and Mr. K.S.Mehta, Brief
Holder for the State/respondent nos. 1
& 2.
Mr. Devesh Upreti, Advocate,
holding brief of Mr. Ashish Joshi,
Advocate for respondent no.3.
Heard.
Issue notice to respondent nos. 4
to 6 by registered post,
acknowledgment due, returnable at an
early date.
Steps to be taken within four day.
Learned counsel for the
respondent no.3 prays for and is
allowed four weeksí time to file counter
affidavit.
List this petition in the 3rd week of
February, 2018.
(Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)

Mamta
